name: How does hiring an owner-operated general contractor compare to hiring separate subcontractors?

mainEntity.name: How does hiring an owner-operated general contractor compare to hiring separate subcontractors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Working with an owner-operated contractor gives you a single direct point of contact who leads the project on-site while managing necessary trade partners. Instead of dealing with multiple independent drywalls, painters, and tile installers, one lead oversees framing, finish carpentry, drywall repairs, and painting directly. For specialized work such as plumbing and electrical rough-ins, the general contractor coordinates licensed sub-trades to ensure work aligns seamlessly with overall finish carpentry and aesthetic plans.
acceptedAnswer.description: An owner-operated general contractor manages the entire schedule, supervises carpentry, drywall, and paint on-site, and coordinates specialized sub-trades directly.
